question.text: Section V of the SEBI-prescribed PPM template is titled 'Governance Structure'. Per the 2021 amendment incorporated via SEBI (AIF) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2021, which additional detail MUST be disclosed in this section in respect of the Investment Committee?

answer.text: Personal tax returns of each IC member
The home addresses and personal mobile numbers of IC members
Terms of reference of the committee constituted for approving the decisions of the AIF (and qualifications/prior work experience of every team member)
A list of all portfolio companies historically rejected by the IC

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 13.5 (Section V disclosures) and footnote 132, inserted by the SEBI (AIF) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2021, detailed information on investment team members including qualification, prior work experience, AND Terms of Reference of the committee constituted for approving decisions of the AIF must be disclosed. **The Trap:** Personal tax returns and home addresses are not required (and would breach privacy). Rejected-deal lists are commercially sensitive and not mandated. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A tests governance disclosures at recall. XIX-C requires knowing the 2021 amendment context for IC Terms of Reference disclosure. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Draft the IC Terms of Reference carefully — over-broad ToR ties your hands on deal approvals; too narrow raises LP concerns on governance. Include quorum, conflict-recusal, and casting vote mechanics.
